name: Descendants' Path
oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card that shares a creature type with a creature you control, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you don't cast it, put it on the bottom of your library.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card that shares a creature type with a creature you control, you may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you don't cast it, put it on the bottom of your library.

needs.what: a library-card selector clause matching a card that shares a creature type with ANY creature matching a filter (here: a creature you control), e.g. shares_a_creature_type_with: {"types": ["Creature"], "controller": "you"}, usable in look_at_top's objects so look_at_top {amount 1, cast_free, rest_to_bottom} with a reveal says the whole sentence
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The selector key shares_a_creature_type_with compares against exactly one object -- "self" or a single-oid binding (selectors._bound_oid ignores list bindings such as reveal's or look_at_top's `as`) -- so it cannot test against the union of creature types of every creature you control. The only free cast from the library that also bottoms a declined card is look_at_top's cast_free + rest_to_bottom, whose pool is filtered by that selector. Inverting it (if + exists over creatures you control sharing a type with the revealed card) fails because the revealed card's binding is a list, and cast_card pays the mana cost rather than casting free. for_each over your creatures would offer the cast repeatedly and is not the printed sentence.
